items.docs: The health check endpoint provides information about the health of a web service. If each of the components required by the service are healthy, then the service is considered healthy and will return a 200 OK response. If any of the components needed by the service are unhealthy, then a 503 Service Unavailable response will be provided.

params.name: limit
params.description: Provide no more than this many items in the response set.  Default = 1000

params.name: offset
params.description: Skip over this many into the response set; used for paginated results.  Default = 0

params.name: unitSystem
params.description:
Identifer for units system used for numerical output values.  Must be either `default` or `metric`.  Default is `default`.
                * `topLevel`: default=`ft`, metric=`m`
                * `bottomLevel`: default=`ft`, metric=`m`

params.name: bbox
params.description: Bounding box coordinates in the format `<min_X>,<min_Y>,<max_X>,<max_Y>`.  The `X,Y` corridinates must be consistent with the `srid` (`4326` for longitude/latitude by default).  Limits to objects within or intersecting the area so defined.  No more than one of `bbox`, `polygon`, `circle`, and `corridor` may be used in one request.

params.name: polygon
params.description: Polygon coordinates in the format `<X_0>,<Y_0>,<X_1>,<Y_1>...,<X_n>,<Y_n>`.  The `X,Y` corridinates must be consistent with the `srid` (`4326` for longitude/latitude by default).  If the last `X,Y` does not match the first `X,Y`, the first `X,Y` is copied to the end to close the polygon.  Limits to objects within or intersecting the area so defined.  No more than one of `bbox`, `polygon`, `circle`, and `corridor` may be used in one request.

params.name: circle
params.description: Circle coordinates and radius distance in the format `<X>,<Y>,<RADIUS>`.  The `X,Y` corridinates must be consistent with the `srid` (`4326` for longitude/latitude by default).  The `<RADIUS>` defines the distance (in default or `distanceUnits`-specified units) from the defined point.  Limits to objects within or intersecting the area so defined.  No more than one of `bbox`, `polygon`, `circle`, and `corridor` may be used in one request.

params.name: corridor
params.description: Line coordinates and distance from the line in the format `<X_0>,<Y_0>,<X_1>,<Y_1>...,<X_n>,<Y_n>,<HALFWIDTH>`.  The `X,Y` corridinates must be consistent with the `srid` (`4326` for longitude/latitude by default).  The `<HALFWIDTH>` defines the distance (in default or `distanceUnits`-specified units) from the line defined by the corridates out to which to create encompassing shape.  Limits to objects within or intersecting the area so defined.  No more than one of `bbox`, `polygon`, `circle`, and `corridor` may be used in one request.

params.name: geometry
params.description: Boolean indicator for inclusion of Geometry in response.  If false, geometry will be returned empty.

params.name: srid
params.description: SRID identifer for coordinate system for spatial filter coordinates.  Default is 4326 (i.e., ordinary longitude & latitude in degrees).

params.name: distanceUnits
params.description: Units identifier for distances in definition for circle or corridor spatial filter.  Default is `nm` (nautical miles).

params.name: isValidAt
params.description: UTC timestamp in format `YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss`.  Limits to objects whose validDateTime is not earlier than the specified value and whose expirationDateTime is later than that specified value.

params.name: fromDateTime
params.description: UTC timestamp in format `YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss`.  Limits to objects whose expirationDateTime is later than that specified value, i.e., only objects not ended by this time.

params.name: untilDateTime
params.description: UTC timestamp in format `YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss`.  Limits to objects whose validDateTime is earlier than the specified value, i.e., only objects that began before this time.

params.name: reportTypes
params.description: Comma-separated list of reportType values.  Must include only allowed values.  Limits to objects whose reportType value matches one of specified parameter values.

params.name: issueOffices
params.description: Comma-separated list of issueOffice values.  Values should be each 4 letters and need to match a Meteorological Watch Office.  Limits to objects whose issueOffice value matches one of specified parameter values.

params.name: firs
params.description: Comma-separated list of firStandardName values.  Values must exactly match items in defined population.  Limits to objects whose firStandardName value matches one of specified parameter values.

params.name: firStartsWith
params.description: Beginning characters of FIR name.  Must be between 2 and 10 characters and only letters, spaces, dashes, and apostrophes allowed.  Results will be provided including data for any FIRs whose names match the input, like for both `GUANGZHOU` and `GUAYAQUIL` if provide `GUA` as value.

params.name: isUrgent
params.description: Boolean indicator for isUrgent.  Limits to objects whose isUrgent value matches parameter value.
